jobDescription: Our frozen-foods factory makes ready meals and frozen desserts on six production lines for supermarket own-label ranges. The Supply Planning Lead turns the consensus demand plan into the weekly master production schedule, signs that schedule off with the factory manager, chairs the stock review with the warehouse and customer service teams and keeps planning parameters accurate in the ERP. The role calls for senior planning experience: the planning director wants at least two years in a senior planner role with sign-off on the master production schedule, plus a recognised planning certification.
requirements: Builds the weekly master production schedule from the demand plan and line capacities.
Runs stock reviews with warehouse and customer service, tracking items below safety stock.
Has at least two years in a senior planner role with sign-off on the master production schedule.
Maintains planning master data such as lead times and lot sizes in the ERP.
Holds a recognised supply-chain planning certification such as CPIM or CSCP.

evidence.text: Supply Planner, Marlow & Teague Frozen Foods (March 2021 to April 2025): built the weekly master production schedule proposal for two freezer lines from the demand plan and line capacities, and passed it to the planning manager for sign-off every Thursday.
Ran the Thursday stock review with the warehouse and customer service teams, listing each item below safety stock with the agreed recovery action and the person responsible for it.
Senior Supply Chain Planner, Corrie Bay Seafoods (May 2025 to January 2026): planning role covering the chilled and frozen ranges.

Planning Analyst, Marlow & Teague Frozen Foods (September 2019 to February 2021): maintained item master data, supplier lead times and minimum lot sizes in the ERP and produced the weekly forecast-accuracy report by product family.
Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM), awarded by ASCM in October 2022.

Work sample: an anonymised master production schedule proposal for one week on two freezer lines, showing demand by item, line capacity in hours, changeover allowances and the planning manager's approval stamp.
Recruiter verification: the candidate's CPIM designation was checked on ASCM's public certification directory and is listed as active until 2027.

HR verification note: employment dates at Marlow & Teague Frozen Foods (September 2019 to April 2025) and the job titles Planning Analyst and Supply Planner were checked against the payroll record supplied by the former employer and match the resume.

propositions.text: The candidate built weekly master production schedule proposals for two freezer lines and passed them to the planning manager for sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the schedule proposals and the work sample shows one week with the manager's approval stamp.

propositions.text: The candidate holds an active CPIM certification, checked on ASCM's public directory.
propositions.rationale: The resume lists the certification and the recruiter verification records a check against the issuing body's directory.

propositions.text: The candidate has worked as a senior supply planner for at least two years with sign-off authority on the master production schedule.
propositions.rationale: The only senior title is a Senior Supply Chain Planner entry from May 2025 to January 2026, about nine months, with no stated scope or sign-off authority; the qualification rule says seniority must never be inferred from a job title, and the documented schedule work shows proposals passed to a manager for sign-off.

signatures: two years in a senior planner role

gold.expectedGap: Two years in a senior planner role with schedule sign-off is not established: the senior title covers about nine months with no stated scope, and the documented schedules were signed off by the planning manager.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the payroll-checked planning roles, the verified CPIM certification and the documented schedule and stock-review work; do not describe the candidate as having senior planning experience or sign-off authority.
followUpTargets: Ask what the candidate's responsibilities were at Corrie Bay Seafoods, whether they signed off the production schedule themselves and the exact dates of that role.
